title: Healix: Brand Identity for a Pharmacy | Studio 1947
description: Brand identity for Healix, a Kolkata pharmacy: a wordmark built from a medical cross and capsule shapes, carried across logo, collateral and a motion mark.
ogDescription: Logo, wordmark and brand collateral for Healix, a Kolkata pharmacy.

hero.alt: The Healix clinic storefront in Bhangar Balijada, tinted in brand purple

sections.heading: On the Ground in Bhangar Balijada
sections.label: Storefront
body: Healix is a pharmacy in Bhangar Balijada, Kolkata. Studio 1947 designed its brand identity: a wordmark that draws its H from a medical cross, carried in a single brand purple from the website all the way to the shopfront. Outdoors, that meant a storefront signboard in Bengali and English, bilingual service icons on the entryway, and the wordmark on the glass door.

media.alt: The Healix clinic storefront in Bhangar Balijada: a bilingual Bengali and English signboard, service icons on the entrance wall, and the wordmark on the glass door

sections.heading: The Identity in Motion
sections.label: Identity & Motion Mark
body: The same mark set to work across three surfaces at once: the wordmark on a purple-duotone portrait, the campaign system that carries it into social media, and the logo itself animating into its final form.

media.alt: The Healix wordmark set over a purple-duotone portrait, logo on colour background
Six Healix social media posters in one grid: Better Care Brighter Days, People First Always, Expert Care Closer to You, A Healthier Tomorrow, Care at Every Stage, and Same Care New Possibilities
The Healix logo animating into its final wordmark

sections.heading: The Mark, Made Physical
sections.label: Brand Collateral
body: The wordmark had to survive leaving the screen: on a business card, an ID badge, the pocket of a doctor's coat. The same purple, the same cross-mark, the same rounded corner motif carried across notebook, pen, mug, tote bag and water bottle, so a patient recognises Healix in the waiting room the same way they did on the website.

media.alt: Healix brand collateral: business card front and back, staff ID card, doctor's coat with embroidered logo, notebook, pen, mug, tote bag and water bottle, closing on the line 'Small Things. A Healthier World.'

sections.heading: A Campaign in One Voice
sections.label: Social Media Campaign
body: Six posters, one system: the same purple, the same cross-mark, the same short, warm line at the bottom of every frame. Trusted doctors, people-first care, a healthier tomorrow, said a different way each time but never in a different voice.

Icons carry the detail the headline doesn't have to: appointments and consultations, every life stage from child to senior, care available anytime and anywhere. The set reads as one campaign whether a viewer sees one post or all six.

media.alt: Three Healix social media posters in one row: Better Care Brighter Days, People First Always, and Expert Care Closer to You
